direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px/52px/1fr/56px, cols 184px/1fr/360px at 1366x768; FactoryStage >=55vw x >=60vh, Inspector internal-scroll only, DecisionBar pinned, no page scroll

colorTokens.stoppedRed: #E5484D only for stopped/offline CELL-MILL-2 outline, OFFLINE/STOPPED text and cross-hatch; owner-required exception to emerald/silver palette
colorTokens.logo: Immutable black/emerald/neon-green/brushed-silver asset, native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story; never recolor, crop, redraw or add elsewhere

direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection/panel; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions, preserves pattern+marker+text

components.Header: 48px; official logo left, live state centre-right, Lock recovery room as button
components.StepRail: 9 steps from single steps array, plus completion state; 36-40px icon+text+state buttons, completed/current/locked, aria-current=step; remove dead Workspaces disclosure
components.GuideStrip: 52px; Step X of 9, instruction + status only, no duplicate primary
components.FactoryStage: Focusable cinematic inline SVG 960x540 synced to inspector selection; dock/held lot, QA gate, conveyor, brushed-silver CELL-MILL-1/2, JOB-1001/1002 bays; every node keyboard-reachable, 2px #A8F04A focus outline offset 2px
components.EvidenceInspector: 360px; current task only, required action pinned, internal scroll only; pre-flight nonce/identity health as separate checklist from investigation evidence task; blocked prior tasks collapsed until replacements approved
components.Consent: Selecting a recovery option opens typed consent form in inspector; exact-phrase match enables acceptance, pinned while comparison scrolls internally, pending form survives read-only history
components.DecisionBar: 56px; Back left, human decision/status centre, one primary right; invalidating actions separated and text-labelled
components.Keyboard: Skip-to-stage first; header > rail > guide > SVG nodes > inspector > DecisionBar; arrows in rail/SVG, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite for results only

visualizations.FactorySVG: State-driven: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only, silver idle, neon feasible/accepted, red only stopped CELL-MILL-2, never route through offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 vs Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning gap; bidirectional SVG-inspector highlight
visualizations.Evidence: Persistent legend Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted, each pattern+marker+text, never colour-only; pending proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan coexist while replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the small logo block above the inspector unless it is the designated opening-story placement; enforce exactly header + opening-story placements and never add a third instance.
Make RECEIVING, quantity tracks, CELL-MILL-1/2 and JOB-1001/1002 focusable SVG nodes with visible focus and bidirectional inspector highlighting.
Increase the dim 40/30-part and evidence labels to at least 11px with silverDim contrast at 1366x768.
Add a distinct pre-flight checklist for nonce/identity health above the route selector, clearly separated from the Sample investigation evidence task.
Keep the route select and Run Sample investigation state explicit: selected route, not-run status, and disabled reason must remain visible without scrolling.
Reduce repeated offline/no-live-AI copy to one status sentence in the inspector.
Keep the exact-phrase input, character count and disabled Accept action pinned while only the three-option comparison scrolls internally.
Replace radio-dot-only selection with a bordered selected card, Selected path text and matching neon route trace in the SVG.
Show phrase mismatch/remaining characters adjacent to the input and announce match state via aria-describedby, not colour alone.
Mark every Britt task consistently as PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL and keep Approve/Decline as the only tracking-changing controls.
Add dependency order t1>t2>t3 arrows and due/after-Ready metadata in tabular type so the proposal can be scanned without reading prose.
Link MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts in the SVG to the selected substitute card in the inspector with shared hover/focus highlight.
On selecting CELL-MILL-2, immediately preview its red cross-hatch, OFFLINE/STOPPED label and broken route in the SVG before Apply second shock; current pre-apply view still shows it available.
Keep Apply second shock visually distinct as the sole primary and retain the centre DecisionBar warning that prior acceptance will be invalidated.
Move Start a fresh scenario (admin) into a separated, text-labelled danger zone away from the shock controls.
Preserve the red-only CELL-MILL-2 hatch and ensure no feasible route line passes through it; show 3-to-2 feasible-path change in the banner and SVG.
Separate pre-flight nonce/identity health from the reinvestigation task, as in Step 2, with independent pass/pending states.
Make CONSTRAINED on Split available capacity pattern-plus-text in both SVG chip and inspector, not text inside the stage alone.
Fix inspector clipping: the constrained option explanation and Human Decision heading are cut by internal scroll; pin the consent form and give the comparison its own bounded scroll region.
Disable selection for the constrained Split option with reason text and a non-colour marker, while keeping the two feasible options selectable into the typed consent form.
Truncate the GuideStrip instruction cleanly without ellipsis cutting meaning at 1366px.
Keep Prior tracked work - 3 BLOCKED collapsed by default and visually separate from the 3 untracked revised tasks awaiting approval.
Add a summary line Approved revised plan + replacement tasks await approval in the inspector header so coexistence is understood before scrolling.
Ensure CELL-MILL-2 remains red-hatched OFFLINE and the accepted flow routes only through CELL-MILL-1 despite the stage title returning to RECOVERY ACCEPTED.

Separate proof actions into three labelled fieldsets - Seal encrypted packet, Verify ledger, Retain independent checkpoint - each with its own button and status; remove the duplicate Verify ledger primary from the DecisionBar or make it the single primary only.
Fix the Before-After panel clipped list and bottom scrollbar by using internal scroll with a visible end state inside the 360px inspector.
Show passphrase requirements as a checklist tied to input validation, without inventing strength results before entry.
Make Review recovery proof in the DecisionBar lead to a read-only completed state distinct from Step 9, with Packet sealed and 18 events retained as the sole status.
Add a completion marker plus Recovery story complete to the rail while preserving all 9 prior steps as completed and keyboard-reachable.
Mask the entered passphrase permanently and label Seal/Verify/Checkpoint outcomes separately so the sealed screenshot cannot be mistaken for an editable proof form.
